csv_project_name: Engineering Svc for South Mooney Bridge
csv_scope_of_work: The Village of Jemez Springs (the "Village") is soliciting sealed proposals from qualified engineering firms to provide professional engineering services for the planning, design, and environmental clearance of the South Mooney Bridge replacement. The project involves the replacement of a 50' single-lane pony truss bridge on Mooney Blvd over the Jemez River. The project will include long range planning, prioritization and programming, study scoping and conceptual design, and preliminary and final design for the South Mooney Bridge.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Engineering Services for South Mooney Bridge
short_description: Engineering services for replacing a 50-foot single-lane pony truss bridge in Jemez Springs.
project_scope: Replacement of the existing 50 ft single-lane pony truss bridge on Mooney Boulevard over the Jemez River. Scope includes long-range planning, prioritization and programming, study scoping, conceptual design, and preliminary and final design, as well as environmental clearance for the bridge replacement project.
services: Professional engineering services for planning, design, and environmental clearance; disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- New bridge replacement project with structural engineering content.
- Bridge span is about 50 ft, exceeding sbp's general 20 m interest threshold only marginally when converted; still a bridge project of interest.
- Includes early-stage planning, conceptual design, preliminary and final design, which offers meaningful design involvement.
- Existing structure is a pony truss bridge, but the replacement is not described as architecturally ambitious or long-span.
- Small construction budget and local road context limit strategic importance.
- Not a pure rehabilitation; it is a replacement, which is more relevant for sbp than maintenance work.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost $500.0K.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated in the tender documents.
references_qualifications: Qualified engineering firms are requested. Disciplines sought include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.

notes: Project number 2026-002. Funding source: NMDOT. Questions deadline: 07/30/2026 05:00 PM MDT. Solicitation documents available online. Multiple contracts may be awarded. Source labels target market as Streets/Highways.
